title: Code Signing Verification
description: Updates are signed by the vendor and verified before installation; unsigned updates are rejected. The signature chain goes to a trusted root. Signing is the update's ID.

demo.code:
import hashlib
pkg = b"update-bytes"
print("signature: valid (root trusted)")
print("install: PROCEED")

title: A/B Partition Updates
description: Two system partitions alternate: the update writes to the inactive one, then the boot switches. Failed updates roll back by switching back. Atomicity through duality.

demo.code:
print("active: A, update -> B")
print("B boots OK -> stay | B fails -> back to A")
_jah_schema = {'technique': 'A/B slots', 'target': 'System image', 'method': 'Inactive write + switch', 'guarantee': 'Atomic update', 'benefit': 'Duality atomicity', 'complexity': 'Medium'}
print("technique:", _jah_schema["technique"])
assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'target', 'method', 'guarantee', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")
